description: This file is a Spring MVC Controller class that manages tax configuration settings in the admin area of a web application. It provides methods to display and save tax configurations for a merchant store.

classes.name: TaxConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling tax configuration views and updates in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current tax configuration for the merchant store.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save the updated tax configuration for the merchant store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up the menu context for the view.
